en: Vintage postcard view of a square in Trento with mountains in the background. In the foreground there is a park with benches, trees, a lamp post, and a monument (the Monument to Dante). Behind it stand large, elegant buildings with red roofs, including the Imperial Hotel. A horse‑drawn carriage is visible in front of the buildings. Printed captions and handwritten Italian text appear at the top and along the right edge.
